const readline = require('readline');
const rl = readline.createInterface({
    input: process.stdin,
    output: process.stdout
});

let input = [];
rl.on('line', (line) => {
    input.push(line);
});

rl.on('close', () => {
    const [n, m] = input[0].split(' ').map(Number);
    const a = input[1].split(' ').map(Number);
    const b = input[2].split(' ').map(Number);
    
    const totalBrackets = n * m;
    const half = totalBrackets / 2;
    
    // Precompute a_mod and b_mod for all positions
    const aMod = new Array(totalBrackets);
    const bMod = new Array(totalBrackets);
    for (let i = 0; i < totalBrackets; i++) {
        aMod[i] = a[i % n];
        bMod[i] = b[i % n];
    }
    
    // DP approach with optimized space
    // dp[j] represents the minimum cost to have j open brackets after processing some brackets
    let dp = new Array(half + 1).fill(Infinity);
    dp[0] = 0;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < totalBrackets; i++) {
        let newDp = new Array(half + 1).fill(Infinity);
        for (let j = 0; j <= half; j++) {
            if (dp[j] === Infinity) continue;
            // Place open bracket
            if (j < half) {
                newDp[j + 1] = Math.min(newDp[j + 1], dp[j] + aMod[i]);
            }
            // Place close bracket
            if (j > 0) {
                newDp[j - 1] = Math.min(newDp[j - 1], dp[j] + bMod[i]);
            }
        }
        dp = newDp;
    }
    
    console.log(dp[0]);
});
